rachel: quick flag  deploybot auto-pinned runtime 8.0 for model=multilang-chat on staging after an uptick in decoding errors for some UTF-8 sequences. Opening thread to decide rollback vs compat-fix. :mag:

deploybot: auto-pin triggered by decoding-errors >0.6% on staging-chat. Pin applied: runtime=8.0 -> 7.9 (block newer). Reason: tokenizer byte-handling change in 8.0 that affects older tokenizers.

omar: telemetry: errors concentrated on CJK + emoji mixes, mostly in batched small requests. Non-batched paths largely unaffected.

sylvie: root cause: tokenizer build in 8.0 switched to a faster byte normalization that drops some zero-width joiner sequences in corner cases. Options:
1) rollback to 7.9 on staging (fast)
2) push a small tokenizer compatibility shim that re-normalizes those sequences (dev ~2h, tests ~1h)
3) re-bake tokenizers for affected models (artifact update ~1h + validation)

rachel: what's the customer impact? Any prod signals?

support: saw a handful of tickets from integration test suites and one internal partner. No broad prod hits. We flagged customers to expect a short mitigation window.

omar: given limited impact, prefer a targeted artifact re-bake for multilang-chat and then unpin in the next change window. Less risky than touching runtime internals.

sylvie: agreed. Re-bake will produce tokenizer v7-compatible artifacts; we'll run the tokenizer-regression suite. ETA 75m.

rachel: ok then let's keep pin on staging to prevent accidental rollforward and schedule repack -> staging test -> unpin in the next window. @deploybot set TTL 10h and annotate "tokenizer-utf8-multilang-repack" and scope=staging-chat.

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy pin runtime=8.0 -> 7.9 --scope staging-chat --ttl 10h --annot "tokenizer-utf8-multilang-repack"
```
deploybot: pin applied at 3629998960. Will monitor alerts.

sylvie: starting repack pipeline now. Will post artifact link and test results here. If repack passes, we'll request an unpin and schedule canary validation before prod rollout.

omar: also adding a quick perf/latency sanity check after unpin; tokenizer changes can affect throughput.

support: prepping a short customer-facing note in case anything slips through during repack.

rachel: thanks. If repack runs into issues, we can revisit the shim option. Leaving thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
